name: DC inventory and boot age
description: Latest VMComputer OS/boot inventory. Supports suffixed and unsuffixed boot/OS columns. Missing boot telemetry stays unknown; boot-age colors are visualization examples, not an enforced restart policy.
kql:
VMComputer
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer
| extend BootTimestamp = todatetime(column_ifexists('BootTime_t', column_ifexists('BootTime', datetime(null)))), OperatingSystem = tostring(column_ifexists('OperatingSystemFullName_s', column_ifexists('OperatingSystemFullName', '')))
| extend BootAgeDays = iff(BootTimestamp <= now(), datetime_diff('day', now(), BootTimestamp), long(null))
| project Computer, BootAgeDays, BootTime = BootTimestamp, OperatingSystem, LastInventoryUpdate = TimeGenerated
| order by Computer asc
